record.exceptions: Reopening staged: backlogs and empty vehicles first, then non-cold-chain goods; cold-chain goods still withheld.
record.imposing_authority: Chinese Dongxing authorities; coordinated Vietnamese implementation
record.enforcement: Actual partial cargo processing April26 supported by official report and named border-guard interview; counts/timing within the day conflict.
record.relationship: Separate recurrence after EA027; do not combine into an uninterrupted December 2021–April 2022 closure.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred.
record.uncertainty: Round11 full-text rereading identifies conflicting throughput claims: official report and shared press passage say hundreds of vehicles, whereas the named border-guard interview in the press article says just over20 by early afternoon and first traffic near noon. Do not harmonize these counts or treat the shared passage as independent confirmation. Both support April26 first partial cargo restoration; not all commodities or general passenger admission.
